contract_plain_english: In the inherited real, one-dimensional, time-dependent setting, acoustic waves traveling in both directions are modeled by two unknown scalar fields: pressure perturbation p and particle velocity u. With constant bulk modulus K and density ρ, they satisfy p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + (1/ρ) p_x = 0 simultaneously. Equivalently, q = (p,u)^T satisfies q_t + A q_x = 0 for A = [[0,K],[1/ρ,0]] [raw PDF page 23, printed page 1, (1.1) and its conventions; raw PDF page 24, printed page 2, (1.5), its explanatory paragraph, and (1.6)]. The selected passage leaves regularity and explicit parameter inequalities unstated [raw PDF page 24, printed page 2, (1.5) and surrounding text].
